backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the NFT marketplace backend with collections, NFT items, user profiles, and issued NFTs; includes admin-only mutation functions, public query functions, and mixes in authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three features related to fixing the admin dashboard race condition with Internet Identity login, ensuring authenticated actor usage, and displaying proper loading/access-denied states.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, and hooks for the NFT gallery app built on the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery, NFT detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections in the admin dashboard, using useCreateCollection and useUpdateCollection hooks with validation, error display, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using confirmation dialogs for deletion and a modal dialog for editing via AdminCollectionForm.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT item, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, and price input in ICP.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnails, collection name, price, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Presentational card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, token ID, owner (shortened principal), mint date, and an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, a main content area, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and toast notifications for auth events.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders route buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional link to the ICP explorer.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component linking to an external NFT collection on Getgems, showing a collection image with loading/error states, title, description, and a trade link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Lichtei, Wheel of Time, etc.) linking to their respective Getgems marketplace pages.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT showing its image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner principal, price, and a copyable field component with clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helpers to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of hardcoded German-language blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light, red light).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls addNFT on the backend actor, then fetches and returns the newly created NFT, with user-friendly auth error parsing and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both collections and NFT item caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old blog backend so static blog posts are used instead.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, with loading state derived from both actor and query status.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued ICRC-7 NFTs via the backend actor's listAllNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems from the backend actor's getAllNFTs method with a 30-second stale time.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-filtered artwork fetch from the deprecated backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts since the blog backend was removed.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, only enabled when the user is logged in and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via the backend actor's listMyNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFTItem by ID from the backend actor, enabled only when actor and ID are available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the currently authenticated caller is an admin by calling the backend actor, ensuring the actor matches the current identity before querying.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status with a configurable timeout and phase-based state machine, handling actor readiness, identity matching, retries, and timeout scenarios.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints an NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success, with auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the backend actor and invalidates the current user profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file uploads to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, auth error parsing, and upload state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed color palette in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles authentication state, admin role verification with timeout, and renders tabbed UI for managing NFT collections and individual NFTs with create/edit forms.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Stub page for the old artwork detail route that now only shows a 'not found' message, as the artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static light-health posts with backend posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for authenticated admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins back to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post detail page that resolves a post by ID from either static data or the backend, then renders its title, publication date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and displays success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Main gallery page featuring a hero banner, a static quote, loading skeletons, error handling, and the NFTCollectionsSection and NFTExplanation components once data is loaded.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching NFT and collection data by ID from URL params and displaying image, metadata, price, and on-chain explorer link with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page showing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login state handling via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page allowing authenticated users to create a new NFT by filling out a form with title, description, price, collection, and image file, then minting it on-chain.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state and feature requests for the Istvan Seidel Portfolio, focusing on fixing a race condition in the Admin Dashboard where the ICP actor initializes with an anonymous identity before Internet Identity login completes, causing false 'access denied' errors.
